title: Universe State
description: Canonical Phase 1 UniverseState facts container for planning or API exchange, represented as four open fact collections, an optional per-target provenance map, and source and confidence summaries.

facts.description: Open map of namespaced dotted fact keys to arbitrary JSON values.

numeric_values.description: Open map of namespaced dotted numeric keys to number values.

set_memberships.description: Open map of namespaced dotted set keys to arrays of JSON scalar members.

event_markers.description: Open map of namespaced dotted event keys to arrays of loosely typed marker objects.

provenance.description: Optional map from a full target, a collection name and then its dotted key, to how the value at that target was established and when. A target with no entry has no recorded provenance. An entry is removed with its value.

additionalProperties.description: How one value was established, and when. Deliberately nothing else: no confidence number and no free text.

kind.description: asserted: a person said so. measured: an instrument or a reading. derived: computed from other facts. proposed: an advisor suggested it and it has not been confirmed.

source_summary.description: Loosely typed summary of sources that informed this UniverseState.

confidence_summary.description: Optional loosely typed confidence summary for the container.
